entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, I'll show you an example first.[n]You better watch closely!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Use this opportunity to Baton Pass and[n]swap your turn with someone else!
You can now pass a party member's 1 More[n]to another party member.
The recipient of the Baton Pass will see an increase[n]to their attack and healing abilities. The recipient[n]can also pass the baton to another party member[n]to increase their abilities as well.
Pass the baton to another party member[n]by pressing the [clr 2]R2 button[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now, strike the enemy's weakness and[n]give the Baton Pass a try!
